Eleanor Neary’s

I hard this on a De Danaan LP but cant remember which one. For me its got a great swing to it and makes good use of the fiddle’s range.

↳ Posted by donnchad on June 7th, 2002.

The DeDannan setting I learned of this tune was done in A maj. And then they go into the Miller of Droghan.

Eleanor Neary was a Chicago piano player, performing and playing sessions from 1930s through the 60s; she passed away in 1993.

Eileen O’Neill

From the playing of Brendan Begley and Caoimhin O Raghallaigh on “A Moment of Madness.” I love this hornpipe, definitely has the features of the style but the first section especially feels like a breath of fresh air. This whole set of hornpipes is great and I’m working on them all.

I’ve been recently exploring the platform TikTok, which I feel slightly too old for, but there is a nice community of young Irish musicians on there who will be on stages and albums soon enough if they aren’t yet. I’ve been adding to the din with a few of my own versions of tunes and songs. I recorded this hornpipe on there, if you’re interested in hearing my take: https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZPR3SCrbF/

↳ Posted by AdamM on February 8th, 2024.
